caveats: ⚑ S1 Charge Speed ▲8.97%: the schema exposes no dedicated charge-speed StatKey; encoded as attackSpeedPct (nearest weapon-state primitive). If attackSpeedPct does not shorten chargeFrames in the engine, this line is effectively inert and must move to `unmodeled` or gain a charge-speed StatKey — it is a shots-fired (damage) line, not a defensive one.
⚑ S2 trigger: 'when attacking with Full Charge' encoded as shotFired, assuming every RL pull on a charge weapon (chargeFrames 90) is a full charge. Uncharged/tap fires would over-fire this block.

⚑ S2 lifesteal is a %-of-damage-dealt continuous effect; the heal primitive models no HP pool, so it is encoded as 10 recovery events (1/s) purely to keep teammates' on-recovery triggers live. Recovery-event COUNT is an authoring choice, not a kit value.

⚑ S2 Max Ammunition ▲1 round uses a flat-rounds StatKey (maxAmmoFlat). A percentage encoding is not usable: the buff targets ALL allies, so +1 round on a 6-round RL magazine (+16.67%) would grant an MG ally ~+50 rounds. If no flat-rounds StatKey exists in the live schema, this line must move to `unmodeled` rather than be approximated by maxAmmoPct.

Burst 348.73% is left FB-eligible-by-timing (no noFb set) and no explicit crit/core/noRange fields — burst-cast damage resolves on the engine's own pre-Full-Burst cast timing, riders take no range bonus automatically, and the kit text carries no core-strike wording.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Yuni (RL/Fire/Defender/Burst II) is a full-team support: S1 grants a team Charge Speed window on every Full Burst entry; S2 fires off her own full-charge shots and grants the team DEF, a 10s attack-damage lifesteal, and +1 magazine round for 5s; her burst is a single instant AoE hit for 348.73% of final ATK plus a 5s immobilize. The DEF grant is offensively inert at scope but retained per the keep-the-stat rule; the lifesteal is retained because it drives teammates' on-recovery triggers. The burst immobilize is unmodeled: the sim has no enemy entity and the boss range/movement script is a fixed measured constant.

audit.kitLine: Affects all allies. On entering Full Burst
audit.effectOrReason: trigger fullBurstEnter + target {kind:'allies'} (no excludeSelf — 'all allies' includes self). Team-FB trigger, not burstCast: she is Burst II and the text says 'entering Full Burst'.
buff attackSpeedPct 8.97, durationSec 10. Weapon-state modifier → gates shots fired → damage-relevant, never skipped. ⚑ stat-key mapping (see flags/caveats).

audit.kitLine: On attacking with Full Charge; all allies
audit.effectOrReason: trigger shotFired + target {kind:'allies'}. chargeCounter was rejected: it dispatches effects[P] one PHASE at a time, which would split this block's three co-applied effects across charges.
buff defPct 2.77, durationSec 10. Inert for damage in v1 but kept per the keep-the-stat rule (future consumer/scaler).

audit.kitLine: Restores 2.77% of atk dmg as HP /10 sec
audit.effectOrReason: heal {ticks:10, intervalSec:1} to allies — no HP amount is modeled; the purpose is emitting recovery events so heal-synergy teammates' 'recovery' triggers fire. Lifesteal is explicitly not skippable on isolation.
buff maxAmmoFlat 1, durationSec 5. Ammo capacity = magazine length = shots per reload cycle → damage. Flat, not percent (ally-scoped percent would scale off each ally's own magazine).
target {kind:'enemy'}; single-target partless boss at scope, so the AoE scope clause is scope-trivial.

audit.kitLine: Deals 348.73% of final ATK as damage.
audit.effectOrReason: flatDamage atkPct 348.73 on trigger burstCast. No core (no 'core strike' wording); crit/range/FB left to engine defaults.

Enemy crowd control. The sim has no enemy entity (enemy targets resolve empty) and boss movement/range is a fixed measured script, so a stun effect would be a no-op; recorded verbatim in unmodeled.burst instead.

flags.reasoning: The kit line is 'Charge Speed ▲', which shortens charge time on charge weapons; the effect schema has no charge-speed StatKey. Skipping is forbidden (weapon-state modifiers ARE damage), so the nearest primitive is used — but if attackSpeedPct only scales fire cadence and not chargeFrames, this encoding delivers zero of the real effect on every charge-weapon ally.
flags.recipe: Read maxAmmo()/cadence + charge handling in sim.ts: check whether attackSpeedPct feeds chargeFrames. If not, add a chargeSpeedPct StatKey that divides chargeFrames by (1 + v/100) and re-point this buff; validate by counting a charge unit's shots over a fixed 10s window with the buff on vs off (expect ~+8.97% charge-phase throughput, not +8.97% total shots, since reload time is unaffected).

flags.estimate: shotFired (assume every RL pull is a Full Charge)
flags.reasoning: 'Activates when attacking with Full Charge' has no schema-level full-charge trigger. Yuni is RL with chargeFrames 90, so the sim's charge weapons fire only fully-charged shots; shotFired is then 1:1 with full charges. If the engine ever emits uncharged pulls for RL, this block over-fires and the three team buffs get near-100% uptime instead of a real duty cycle.
flags.recipe: DBG_UNIT=yuni with an onEvent tap counting 'shot' events vs charge completions over 180s; confirm 1:1. If they diverge, gate the block or add a fullCharge trigger.

flags.estimate: 6 charges per magazine, ~1.5s per charge + ~2.35s reload → ~1 refresh per ~1.5s while firing
flags.reasoning: Datamined chargeFrames/reloadFrames are known-unreliable fields, and this cadence sets the refresh rate of all three S2 team buffs (DEF / lifesteal / +1 ammo). The 5s ammo window in particular is shorter than a full magazine+reload cycle, so its uptime is cadence-sensitive.
flags.recipe: Frame-count a focus recording of yuni: measure charge-release interval and reload duration from the ammo counter, then pin as a vitest fixture in scripts/tests/units/yuni.test.ts asserting the shot count over a fixed window.

flags.reasoning: The real mechanic is per-hit lifesteal proportional to damage dealt, which the schema cannot express (no HP pool). Tick count is an authoring choice that directly sets how often teammates' on-recovery triggers fire — too many ticks over-credits a heal-synergy carry, too few under-credits.
flags.recipe: Only matters when a recovery-consumer is in the comp. A/B the comp with ticks 1 vs 10 and compare the consumer's proc count against a recording's popup count for that consumer's on-recovery rider.

flags.estimate: flat +1 round for 5s to all allies
flags.reasoning: The kit states a flat round count, and the buff is team-wide, so a percentage encoding is not merely imprecise — it scales off each recipient's own magazine and would grant large-magazine allies many extra rounds. The flat key is required for correctness here, not convenience.
flags.recipe: Confirm the flat-rounds StatKey name against src/skills/types.ts and that maxAmmo() applies it BEFORE percentage scaling; assert with a buffApply tap that each ally's effective magazine rises by exactly 1 for 5s.

flags.estimate: left at engine defaults — FB-by-timing, no explicit noFb, no core, crit per engine rider rule
flags.reasoning: Per methodology, noFb is measured-only and defaults OFF, and a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens, so the timing path — not a per-kit flag — should exempt it. Setting noFb blind would be an unmeasured guess; the kit text carries no core-strike wording, so no core.
flags.recipe: Tap the damage event for this hit and read inFullBurst/fbMajorApplied at cast; it should be false. If the engine applies the +50% FB major to it, the fix belongs in the burst-cast timing path (or burstSnapshotsPreFb), not in a per-unit noFb.
